name: Soyuz T-13
about: Soyuz T-13 (1985-043A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1985 Jun  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1985 Jul 14), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
